_fixture: Screen-level fixtures for the av screen family (av/video, av/karaoke, av/broadcast, av/mic). Invented for the design prototype; nothing here was measured, decoded, transmitted or heard. The shared component data stays in fixtures/av.json (read-only for this family). Values below are what each drawn state needs beyond that file: the visual crossfader position when unlinked, the late-decoding / scratch example, the test-receiver report, the broadcast restriction example and the karaoke transport acknowledgements.

transitions.label: Cut
transitions.detail: Switches the program picture at once.

transitions.label: Dissolve
transitions.detail: Blends program pictures over the transition length.

transitions.label: Video crossfade
transitions.detail: Picture follows a crossfader position (linked or unlinked).

scratch.note: Deck A is being scratched; exact reverse / scratch video is not certified on this device profile.

unsupported.reason: HDR-to-SDR conversion is not handled on this device profile.
